description: Append-only claim graphs (Claim, Edge, Entity, Perspective), one or more per node, each with its own vocabulary profile, admitted only through a mechanical gate plugin, with challenges and reviews, derived status, dispute and reputation views, JSONL export, and a subject-matter expert agent that answers with claim ids.

inference_slots.description: Answers questions from the claim graph with a claim id on every statement and files the questions it cannot answer. Any capable profile.
inference_slots.name: sme

name: claim_graph

bind_dir.description: Narrative source root for quote and file checks

plugins.description: Validates a ClaimBatch against its graph's profile like the research gate and admits its rows, and any new profile version, in one transaction with a receipt.

batch_id.description: The batch's unique id; every admitted row and the receipt carry it.

extractor.description: Who or what extracted the batch.

gate_now.description: Fixes checked_at for reproducible plugin cases; the callback binding never sends it.

graph_id.description: The graph the batch belongs to; ids are unique within a graph.

profile.description: JSON text of a ClaimGraph profile to admit as the graph's next version; required on a graph's first batch.

section.description: The claims file stem the batch's claims belong to.

source_root.description: The narrative source root inside an allowed folder; without it file and quote checks are skipped.

plugins.name: claim_gate

bind_dir.description: The folder the claim graph is exported into as claims/, edges/, entities/ and perspectives/ JSONL files

plugins.description: Exports one claim graph as the research JSONL files (claims per section, edges, entities, perspectives) and its profile versions, sorted by id, or counts them with dry_run.

dry_run.description: Return the counts only and write nothing.

out_dir.description: The folder to write the JSONL tree into, inside an allowed folder.

out_dir_original.description: Set by the host to the real path of out_dir; ignored by the plugin.

sections.description: Only these claim sections; default every section.

plugins.name: claim_export

bind_dir.description: The folder view Markdown is written into as <graph_id>/<view>.md

plugins.description: Derives a view of one claim graph (effective status, open disputes, or per-perspective reputation counts) as Markdown in a ViewReceipt, optionally written to a file.

dry_run.description: Render the view into the receipt only and write no file.

graph_id.description: The graph to derive the view from.

out_dir.description: The folder to write <graph_id>/<view>.md into, inside an allowed folder; without it the Markdown is only in the receipt.

out_dir_original.description: Set by the host to the real path of out_dir; ignored by the plugin.

request_id.description: The ViewRequest correlation key; the receipt carries it.

plugins.name: claim_views
